title: Tiramisu cake near Westmead or Parramatta? 100% eggless, Harris Park
summary:
Tiramisu cake without eggs near Westmead? Traditional tiramisu cream is made with raw eggs. Ours has none.

Every Num Num's cake is 100% eggless, Tiramisu included. Not the sponge, not the cream, not any of our 15 flavours. Which is why vegetarian and Jain families around Westmead and Parramatta can order it without asking a single question.

A 6-inch serves 6-8 and starts at $39.99. An 8-inch serves 12-14 from $49.99. Fresh to order, so we need 2 days' notice. Pickup from Wigram Street, Harris Park, daily 11am to 10pm. Less than 2 km from Parramatta CBD.

Send your size and date on WhatsApp: +61 425 697 725. We speak Hindi and Gujarati too.

It's called tiramisu. It just doesn't have the eggs.
